recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit. Removing system-wide search would contradict the applied FHIR-5700 resolution and later published search issues; any future removal should be handled as a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5700 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core HTTP issue asking to remove system-wide search. The final Jira comments resolved instead to limit cross-resource search to base/common parameters, add a reference and _text guidance, and define Encounter, RelatedPerson, Practitioner, and Device compartments.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 5229cf7f3915899b829cd4d5e3780a4bfd916b17, svn revision 4386, applied the relevant HTTP/search/compartment changes for #5700 by moving all-resource search into variant guidance, limiting it to all-resource parameters, adding _text-related common-parameter guidance, and adding the requested compartments.
additional_context: Later published issues refined the same root-search family without reversing the compromise: FHIR-10459 corrected the all-resource GET URL, FHIR-13836 clarified _type/common-parameter rules, FHIR-12148 added explicit cross-resource _type support, and FHIR-36347 moved detailed parameter guidance to search.html#type.
reconciliation: The current combined-branch source already has whole-system search as constrained guidance, the Search page limits no-_type root searches to parameters common to all resource types and lists _text among common parameters, and compartments.xml contains Encounter, RelatedPerson, Practitioner, and Device compartments.
